ideas.name: any warning in the hour after a coupon auction
ideas.why: a note or bond auction's result reprices yields at the close (12:00 CT); equities follow for the next hour, so moves carry and turns fail

ideas.name: any warning after an auction, calling its way
ideas.why: a weak auction (bid-to-cover under 0.95 of the term's usual) pushes yields up and Nasdaq down; a strong one (over 1.05) the reverse. After the close, a turn calling that way has the rates flow behind it

ideas.name: any warning on a mega-cap earnings session
ideas.why: the first session after AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, AMZN, META, GOOGL, AVGO or TSLA reports (about 40% of the index): the index reprices, so moves carry and turns fail

ideas.name: any warning on a quarterly expiry day
ideas.why: quad witching and the Nasdaq-100 rebalance: dealers' hedges roll off and index funds trade at the close; pinning through the day, so turns pay

ideas.name: any warning against leveraged funds' crowded side
ideas.why: leveraged funds' net NQ position in the top (bottom) fifth of the last year: trend followers are crowded long (short), and a turn against them has their unwinding behind it

ideas.name: any warning the way asset managers are adding
ideas.why: asset managers' net share of open interest rising (falling) over four weeks is slow real-money buying (selling); a turn that way has it behind it
